text:
maria: Heads-up — the eval CI stopped sending results to the reporting dashboard ~10m ago after the midnight deploy. Dashboard shows a gap for all quant/eval runs.
akshay: seeing same. Reporter 502/410 on webhook POSTs. Any running rollback? :grimacing:
ci-bot: [alert] 1836001200 - 1836001230 - 6 failed webhook deliveries to https://reporting.internal/api/webhook (HTTP 502)
lin: I pulled the runner logs: `2026-03-19T23:52:41Z eval-runner webhook_client.go:87 POST https://reporting.internal/api/webhook -> 502 Bad Gateway` repeated. Also `Client error: read tcp ... i/o timeout` in some attempts.
maya: Did the reporting service change its auth or TLS? cert rotation maybe?
maria: I checked the certs — nothing rotated. Reporting team says they didn't deploy. They saw a spike in malformed payloads earlier though.
devon: Do we have the failed payload sample? Could be a payload shape change from the new eval-ci patch.
lin: grabbed a sample from the runner archive:
```
POST /api/webhook HTTP/1.1
Host: reporting.internal
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
{
  "run_id": "r-20260319-42",
  "model": "llama2-q8",
  "metrics": [{"name":"winrate","value":0.72}],
  "extra": null
}
```
maya: Reporting says `extra: null` previously wasn't allowed; their contract expects `{}` or omitted. But we didn't change that intentionally.
akshay: Which commit touched eval-runner webhook serialization? I can start a quick git bisect on the runner repo.
tara: ci-bot disabled webhooks automatically after 5 failures at 1836001260 — it also enqueued the payloads to S3 fallback bucket: `s3://redwood-eval-fallback/1836001234/`.
maria: Good fallback. We need fast mitigation — either fix serialization + hotfix or re-enable webhook + patch.
devon: I started a narrow test: re-run the latest runner with `EXTRA="{}"` env override and it posts successfully to reporting endpoint. So serialization is likely passing null -> `null` literal.
akshay: Bisect result: culprit is commit abcdef9 in PR #4127 — changed the JSON marshaller to preserve nil fields to be explicit `null` for GC reasons. It was intended for internal logs.
lin: OK rollback plan: revert abcdef9 on prod runners and re-deploy. Also add a transform to drop `extra: null` on sender side as a bandaid.
maya: Also file issue with reporting to accept `null` or at least tolerate it. But we can't rely on them to change fast.
maria: Action items:
- akshay: open rollback PR and coordinate deploy (priority: P0)
- lin: add strip-null transform in eval-runner (short patch) and add unit test
- tara: monitor fallback S3 queue and replay once fixed
- devon: add acceptance test to CI that posts a variety of payload shapes to reporting endpoint
- maya: contact reporting infra to communicate rollback and ask for tolerant parsing

akshay: I'll have a rollback PR in 15m and start canary.
maria: After rollback, we should also add an alert that fires when webhook 4xx/5xx rate > 1% for 5m and a dashboard panel for delivery failures.
ci-bot: [info] rollback PR opened: https://git.internal/r/runner/PR/4182 — canary started on runner-canary-3
lin: canary logs show successful POSTs now, responses 200, replaying 10 items from S3 succeeded.
maya: reopening the eval release to blocked -> resolved in the release tracker.
maria: thanks everyone. We'll follow up with a postmortem w/ timeline and test to prevent `null` fields in contract-sensitive payloads. :thumbsup:
